biotools.summary: DS4H Image Alignment (DS4H-IA) is an open-source ImageJ/Fiji plugin designed for aligning multimodality, immunohistochemistry, and immunofluorescence microscopy images with a focus on user-friendliness. It provides a solution for image registration with readily available source code, standalone applications, video tutorials, documentation, and sample datasets.
